items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Feather had one out, called, 'The Hot Discography,' or something like that... Even Leonard Feather liked it.

ctx.x: Is there, to your knowledge, a discography of your recordings, a complete list of everything you did?

Yeah, I've got a couple of them. One that is fairly up to date. It comes -- well, it doesn't have the last record in it. I think it does. It mentions it. '67 and '66. Yes, because it's got a mention of that Reader's Digest date I did, which it says unissued, which is not true. It was issued through Reader's Digest, but not in the stores. But that's actually the last record date. Yeah, this is, oh it's a book, I'd say, about three quarters of an inch thick, and it's got everything listed, and it's pretty thorough.…
